entities.name: Oana Vitellius
entities.description: An overworked Azorius defender who, after being tricked by a Dimir agent, becomes a celebrated arbiter and decades later confesses.

entities.name: Tarem
entities.description: A Dimir agent and vampire who offers Oana her dead grandfather's memories and returns forty years later to collect payment.

entities.name: Otho Vitellius II
entities.description: A famous Azorius arbiter, Oana's late grandfather, entombed in a crypt with a statue of himself.

entities.name: Arbiter Johvann III
entities.description: A monotone Azorius arbiter who convicts a vegetable merchant over a reclassification of his produce.

entities.name: Arrester Petri
entities.description: A young Lyev soldier who recounts the testimony against the vegetable merchant.

entities.name: Azorius Senate
entities.description: The Ravnican guild of law and its governing body, based in New Prahv.

entities.name: House Dimir
entities.description: The Ravnican guild of secrets, to which Tarem belongs.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: A Ravnican guild whose theft case Tarem demands Oana rule on.

entities.name: New Prahv
entities.description: The Azorius seat of government and courts on Ravnica.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The guild-run city plane where the story is set.

events.summary: Oana, a harried defender, arrives late to court in New Prahv.
events.quote: She was late. That was almost a given.

events.summary: Arbiter Johvann convicts Oana's vegetable-merchant client for selling reclassified medicinal supplies without a license; his stock is destroyed and permits revoked.
events.quote: You are found guilty of selling medicinal supplies without a license.

events.summary: Oana rants in a bar over losing the case and blames herself.
events.quote: I can't keep up, and a decent man lost his business because of me.

events.summary: Tarem approaches Oana and offers to transfer her dead grandfather's memories and training to her.
events.quote: It can transfer the memories and training from the dead to the living.

events.summary: Oana identifies him as Dimir, angrily refuses and promises to destroy his kind, then goes home uneasy.
events.quote: I will continue his work, and I will earn the right to destroy you.

events.summary: Oana wakes with new drive and wins four acquittals, never late for any trial.
events.quote: The following day, spurred on by her newfound drive, she earned four acquittals, and argued a fifth client's sentence down to probation and a trivial fine.

events.summary: Decades later, Arbiter Oana, near sixty, visits her grandfather's crypt on the first day of the month.
events.quote: After her last case of the first day of each month, Oana made a pilgrimage to her grandfather's crypt.

events.summary: Tarem, unaged, reappears in Oana's home to collect on her promise, demanding she acquit a man in a Izzet League theft case.
events.quote: Tomorrow, you will hear a case involving a theft from the Izzet League.

events.summary: Oana learns she had no grandchildren; she remembers being the young girl herself, realizing the memory of her accepting the bargain was erased.
events.quote: She was looking at herself as a child, which meant...

events.summary: Restored memory (flashback): at the bar Oana had rationalized the deal as legal and agreed to owe Tarem one favor to be named later.
events.quote: "One favor to be named later. And I agreed."

events.summary: Oana resigns, files a confession and recuses herself from her cases, then seeks a lawyer.
events.quote: Oana spent the next morning writing her letter of resignation and her official statement of confession.

relations.quote: Oana Vitellius, granddaughter of the famous arbiter, Otho Vitellius II.
The Dimir agent bowed politely and made an unhurried exit.

relations.note: Oana serves the Azorius as defender and later arbiter.
relations.quote: Her chambers were decorated with the memorabilia of thirty years of service to the Azorius

relations.note: She vows to destroy him, later is coerced by him.
relations.quote: Do you remember my promise, Dimir?
